# Tap Time Tracker

> Tap Time Tracker is a free one-tap time tracker that runs in the browser: one big button per activity, tap when you switch, and see your day, week and month laid out. There is no account, and what you track never leaves your device.

Key facts:

- Works like a chess clock: tapping an activity starts it and stops the one that was running; only one runs at a time. Tapping the running one stops tracking.
- Forgotten switches are fixed afterwards: hold an activity and set when it really started ("active since 10:40"); the time moves over from whatever was running.
- Privacy: no sign-up, no ads, no cookies. Everything is stored in the browser's own storage (IndexedDB) on the device and is never uploaded. The site counts visits anonymously (Umami, no cookies), never what is tracked, and that can be turned off.
- What can be tracked: any activity the user adds in Settings (one name or a whole list at once), each with a color and an optional daily target. Activities can be sorted into groups (e.g. Work and Home, switched on and off), tagged with the user's own categories (e.g. deep vs. shallow work, a client), and hidden for the day.
- Summary of a day, week, month or any range on one clock, grouped by your own categories; daily targets; profiles; three layouts; seven themes plus imported ones; full-screen / wall-display use.
- Mini window (desktop Chrome and Edge): a small always-on-top picture-in-picture window with the running activity, its time, today's total and previous / stop / next buttons, for switching while working in other apps.
- Runs on any modern browser (laptop, tablet, phone, touchscreen) and offline once opened; installable to the home screen or desktop. No sync between devices: data moves with an exported JSON backup file. There is no CSV or Excel export yet (planned). Time for clients or billable work is tracked with categories; there are no hourly rates or invoices.
- Free, with no paid tier; everything it does today stays free, and any paid extras would be additions. Available in English, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Portuguese, Turkish, Italian, Persian, Dutch, Chinese and Ukrainian.
- Contact: contact@taptimetracker.app

## Pages

- [Home](https://taptimetracker.app/): what it does, how it works, privacy, and frequently asked questions (https://taptimetracker.app/#faq)
- [The app](https://taptimetracker.app/app/): the tracker itself
- [Live demo](https://taptimetracker.app/app/?demo): the app on three weeks of sample data, in a sandbox
- [Similar apps](https://taptimetracker.app/similar/): a ranked comparison of 13 similar time trackers and how they differ
- [Privacy](https://taptimetracker.app/privacy/): what is stored where, and the anonymous usage stats
- [Terms of use](https://taptimetracker.app/terms/)

## Other languages

Every page except privacy and terms exists under a language prefix: /es/, /de/, /fr/, /ja/, /pt/, /tr/, /it/, /fa/, /nl/, /zh/, /uk/ (for example https://taptimetracker.app/de/similar/). The full list is in https://taptimetracker.app/sitemap.xml.
